title.narrative: Access to Basic Services and Performance Improvement Project (PASBAP)

description.narrative: The PDO is to increase access to water supply, sanitation, and electricity services and improve performance in the water supply and electricity sectors in Gabon.

The Project aims to increase access to water supply, sanitation, and electricity services and improve performance in the water supply and electricity sectors in Gabon. The Project finances: (i) the construction and rehabilitation of water supply and electricity infrastructure in urban and rural areas; (ii) technical assistance to sector institutions to improve their capacities to plan, develop, manage, monitor and regulate water, sanitation, and electricity services; (iii) the procurement and installation of meters, regularization of connections, extension of access to both services, and improved management systems to reduce losses and improve cost-recovery and service continuity, particularly in Greater Libreville where 36 percent of the Gabonese live; (iv) the construction of a fecal sludge treatment plant in Greater Libreville; and (v) studies for critical short- and medium-term investments to improve electricity service delivery in Gabon.
